scenario.title: The Whispering Vault
scenario.premise: The abbey of Saint Corvin was abandoned in a single night. Kael has come for the sealed vault beneath it, and the abbot's study is the only room still lit.

entities.name: the abbot's study
entities.brief: A cramped room of ledgers and cold candle stubs; a loose flagstone hides something under the desk.

entities.name: the cloister
entities.brief: A frost-rimed colonnade around a dead garden; Brother Tomas sweeps it to no purpose.

entities.name: the bell tower
entities.brief: A cramped climb of rotten ladders above the nave, its bell long since stilled.

entities.name: the sealed vault
entities.brief: The undercroft chamber Kael came for, its door bearing a seal nobody living can read.

detail.description: The door is stone, and the seal cut into it is unweathered where everything around it has worn.
detail.when_reached: Kael has found the vault door: advance thread vault-seal to stage door-found. The seal is the whole obstacle now — press on what opening it will cost.

entities.name: Mara
entities.brief: The abbey's last scribe, cautious and tired, still cataloguing books nobody will read.

entities.name: Brother Tomas
entities.brief: A deaf old porter who sweeps the cloister and knows almost nothing about the vault.

entities.name: Elena
entities.brief: The vault's former archivist, hiding in the bell tower; she alone remembers the sealing rite; she catalogued the vault ledgers beside Mara for two winters, until the night she went below alone and never came back up.

detail.description: She carries the sealing rite in her head and nowhere else.
detail.when_reached: Kael has found the archivist: advance thread vault-seal to stage archivist-found. She will name a price before she gives the rite up, and the rite is not known until she has.

entities.name: a bloated rat
entities.brief: It has grown fat on the dead garden and does not run from a lantern.

entities.name: the vault map
entities.brief: A creased chart of the undercroft, marking a stair the abbey's own plans deny.

detail.description: Drawn in an old hand; the undercroft it maps is larger than the abbey standing over it.
detail.when_reached: Kael has the stair charted: advance thread vault-seal to stage stair-charted. The chart marks a way down from the cloister that the abbey's own plans deny — press on getting down there.

entities.name: a guttering lantern
entities.brief: A dented tin lantern whose flame will not hold still.

traits.name: Unsteady Lantern
traits.text: (gear) Its shifting light exposes seams and movement in deep shadow.

entities.name: Kael
entities.brief: A scarred relic-hunter who came to the abbey for what is sealed beneath it.

traits.name: Relic Hunter
traits.text: (skill) Kael knows how old sanctums conceal what matters.

traits.name: Marked by the Past
traits.text: (frailty) Old scars make certain memories hard to face.

threads.title: The sealed vault
threads.note: Kael came for the vault under the abbey: the way down to it, the seal on its door, and what opening that seal costs.
